headline: President Bush made another change to the 1997 order that set up a presidential advisory committee on information technology.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13035, which created the President's Information Technology Advisory Committee, a group that advises the President on computing and technology issues. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here. Orders like this often adjust a committee's membership, duties, or end date.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the President's Information Technology Advisory Committee
who_it_affects.how: The rules for how the committee is set up or run may have changed.

when_it_takes_effect: 2001-05-31 (date signed; actual effective date not stated)
